title: Uakifishi: (Theme 5: Mnyama nimpendaye)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads each sentence aloud and asks: does it want an answer? Then he puts ? or . and starts the next one big.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a short sentence with a capital at the start.
floor.question: Andika: Baba analima.

representations: a question card and a statement card
the marks . and ? cut out to place
a passage with the marks missing
steps: Ask: does it ask or tell?
Start the next sentence with a capital.
contexts: writing questions for a class interview

board.do: Point at the end of the sentence.
board.say: Sentensi hii inaishia kwa alama gani?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes one question and one statement about the theme with their marks.

misconceptions.repair: Sentensi ya kueleza huishia kwa kikomo (.).
Sentensi hii inaeleza kwamba swali liliulizwa; huishia kwa kikomo.

misconceptions.ask: Neno linalofuata kikomo linaanza kwa herufi gani?

checks.question: Weka alama: Je, sungura anakula nini
